title: A multi-modal human neuroimaging dataset for data integration: simultaneous EEG and fMRI acquisition during a motor imagery neurofeedback task: XP1
description: A multi-modal neuroimaging dataset (XP1) with simultaneous 64-channel EEG and fMRI recorded while 10 participants performed right-hand kinaesthetic motor imagery with neurofeedback. Each participant completed motor localizer, pre- and post-training motor imagery runs, and three neurofeedback runs (EEG-only, fMRI-only, and bimodal EEG-fMRI). The release includes raw and preprocessed EEG, BOLD fMRI, anatomical data, and EEG and BOLD neurofeedback scores to support multi-modal data integration.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel MR-compatible Brain Products system at 5 kHz (FCz reference, AFz ground). fMRI was acquired on a 3T Siemens Verio with an EPI sequence (TR=2 s, TE=23 ms, 2x2x4 mm resolution, 32 slices). The protocol used 20 s rest/task block designs. EEG was preprocessed in BrainVision Analyzer II with gradient and ballistocardiogram artifact correction, downsampling to 200 Hz, and a 50 Hz low-pass filter. fMRI data for BOLD neurofeedback scores were preprocessed with SPM8.
